incomplete_fix_quote: This is a variation of the vulnerability reported in CVE-2021-28164/GHSA-v7ff-8wcx-gmc5.
original_example_quote: a request to /context/%2e/WEB-INF/web.xml can retrieve the web.xml file
residual_example_quote: the default mode allows URIs containing a %u002e segment to reach protected resources; an encoded null character can prevent correct normalization so that /.%00/WEB-INF/web.xml can also retrieve the web.xml file
sink: org.eclipse.jetty.http.HttpURI / URIUtil.canonicalPath decode-vs-normalize ordering + ContextHandler.isProtectedTarget authorization-before-canonicalization gate guarding WEB-INF
mechanism: Jetty's protected-target authorization check runs before the request URI is fully decoded and normalized. The 9.4.39 fix rejected the plain %2e dot-segment but left Jetty's non-standard %uXXXX decoding and encoded-null handling intact, so %u002e and .%00 still decode/normalize to a '.' segment that walks into WEB-INF past the guard. 9.4.43 restored decode-before-normalize ordering and rejects ambiguous URIs, closing both.
